headline: Personal training with a pre and postnatal focus in Ceredigion
bio: Nerth is a woman-led Welsh fitness business in Ceredigion run by Samantha Ackerman. It offers personal training with a speciality in pre and postnatal fitness, plus dance and mobility classes and an on-demand online class library.
name: Nerth

headline: Friendly Pilates and fitness classes around Aberystwyth
bio: Helen Stockley Jones runs friendly Pilates and fitness classes in and around Aberystwyth. She has over 25 years of teaching experience and a degree in Sport and Exercise Science, and adapts every exercise so all abilities can take part.
name: HSJ Fitness

headline: Fitness, Pilates and sports therapy studio in Aberystwyth
bio: EAB Fitness and Wellness Studio in Aberystwyth brings fitness, Pilates, sports therapy and massage together under one roof. It supports people recovering after injury as well as those chasing better performance, and also runs online Pilates classes.
name: EAB Fitness and Wellness Studio

headline: Evidence-based fitness coaching, classes and menopause workouts
bio: Rachel Hubbard BSc offers evidence-based fitness coaching in Welsh and English, with weekly classes, retreat days and an online programme. Her site also has menopause video workouts and free downloads.
name: Rachel Hubbard Fitness

headline: Level 3 personal trainer in Llandudno with 4 to 12 week plans
bio: Ethan of EGJ Fitness is a Level 3 personal trainer in Llandudno with NASM weight loss and nutrition specialist qualifications. He offers 4, 8 and 12 week plans and a free trial session so you can see if PT suits you.
name: EGJ Fitness

headline: Personal trainer in Llandudno with over 20 years of experience
bio: Antony Bertola is a Llandudno personal trainer with more than 20 years of experience. Sessions are tailored to all ages, with flexible times and both indoor and outdoor options, and he also teaches swimming.
name: Antony Bertola Personal Training

headline: Physiotherapy plus Pilates and stretch classes near Llandudno
bio: Peak Physio and Fitness is a physiotherapy clinic serving Conwy and Llandudno Junction. Alongside treatment for pain and injury it runs a timetable of Pilates and stretch classes, with services moving to a new clinic at Bodlondeb, Conwy.
name: Peak Physio and Fitness

headline: Circuit training and weight loss classes in Colwyn Bay
bio: Yianni's Fitness runs circuit training and group fitness classes in Colwyn Bay. Trainers guide each workout with personal attention, and the 6 Week Shred programme suits anyone wanting to lose weight or build muscle.
name: Yianni's Fitness

headline: Personal trainer and online coach in Carmarthen
bio: Richard Robbins is a VTCT Level 3 personal trainer and nutrition coach in Carmarthen with over 15 years in the fitness industry. He trains people face to face in a local gym or online, and sells home workout and training plans.
name: Animal Performance

headline: Fun, varied personal training in Carmarthen
bio: Charles is an experienced personal trainer in Carmarthen who keeps fitness fun, varied and accessible for all abilities. A keen rock climber, runner and surfer, he focuses on real-world improvements that matter to each client.
name: Physical Peak

headline: Personal training, nutrition coaching and workout plans in Bridgend
bio: Bionic Fitness is run by Bethan Littlewood, a Bridgend personal trainer who rebuilt her own fitness after cancer treatment and went on to compete for Bridgend Sharks and Great Britain. She offers personal training, nutrition coaching, workout plans and free YouTube workouts.
name: Bionic Fitness

headline: Women-only small group personal training in Bridgend
bio: Revive is a women-only training space in Bridgend running small group personal training sessions. Coaches tailor each session to your goals, with flexible booking through the week and a supportive community of like-minded women.
name: Revive Personal Training

headline: Personal trainer covering Bridgend and the Vale of Glamorgan
bio: Matthew Pearce has over 10 years of experience as a REPs-registered personal trainer, specialising in sport, nutrition and fitness. He is also a qualified tennis coach and advanced Boxercise instructor, and offers one-to-one and partner training around Bridgend and the Vale.
name: Exercise Your Life

headline: Personal trainer in Brackla who lost over 100lb himself
bio: Matthew founded MC2 Fitness after losing over 100lb and going on to complete marathons, ultras, Ironman races and HYROX. He trains clients in Brackla and around Bridgend, with a focus on mindset, daily movement and habits that last.
name: MC2 Fitness

headline: Physio-led Pilates classes in Bridgend
bio: CLWB Pilates runs physio-led Pilates classes in Bridgend and Aberdare. Every class is taught by a qualified physiotherapist, so it suits people recovering after injury as well as anyone wanting more strength and flexibility.
name: CLWB Pilates

headline: Classical and rehab Pilates with Tina Lloyd in Bridgend
bio: Tina Lloyd teaches Pilates in Bridgend as a Peak Pilates classical instructor and APPI certified mat instructor for rehabilitation.
name: TrePilates

headline: Award-winning Pilates for all shapes and sizes in Bridgend
bio: Pear Shaped Pilates teaches evidence-based Pilates in Bridgend for people of every age, ability and size. It won Best Health and Fitness at the 2024 Best of Welsh Business Awards, specialises in pre and postnatal exercise and offers on-demand videos.
name: Pear Shaped Pilates

headline: Dedicated group reformer Pilates studio in Elgin
bio: High Vibe Studio is a dedicated reformer Pilates studio in Elgin, Moray, running group classes for every body regardless of experience, age or size. New clients can start with an intro pack.
name: High Vibe Studio

headline: Personal training and obstacle race coaching in Moray
bio: Andy Bentley found his love of training in the Royal Air Force and has since qualified for the Obstacle Course Racing World and European Championships. A Level 3 personal trainer in Moray, he offers PT, running, group exercise and OCR training.
name: Odyssey Personal Training

headline: Advanced personal trainer and cancer rehab specialist in Moray
bio: Louise Cartmell is a REPs Level 4 personal trainer in Moray with a first class sport and fitness degree and over 10 years of experience. She is a Level 4 cancer rehabilitation specialist, GP referral qualified and a kickboxing black belt.
name: Louise Cartmell Personal Trainer

headline: One-to-one personal training in Elgin plus a home workout app
bio: Ross is a personal trainer in Elgin who keeps fitness simple and meets people where they are. Alongside one-to-one sessions he built Core Buddy, a ten-minute home workout app that times every move for you.
name: Mind Core Fitness

headline: Online personal training and Pilates classes in Moray
bio: Helen Wright offers one-to-one online personal training and Pilates classes in Moray. Her time-efficient programmes fit busy lives, with realistic support on fitness, lifestyle and stress.
name: Helen Wright Fitness

headline: Independent, bespoke personal training in Forres
bio: HJ Personal Trainer offers independent, bespoke personal training in Forres and the Moray Firth area, plus online coaching and a 50+ gym class. Clients include older adults, ante and postnatal women, children, people in rehab and those with medical conditions.
name: HJ Personal Trainer

headline: Holistic Pilates and personal training in Oban
bio: Fiona MacInnes of Fusion Fit is a personal trainer and Pilates teacher in Oban with over 13 years of teaching. She trained with Hanson Pilates and brings a love of endurance running and holistic movement to her sessions.
name: Fusion Fit

headline: Clinical Pilates and movement rehabilitation in Oban
bio: Jenny at Core Pilates Oban helps people with persistent pain, injury recovery, pelvic health and confidence in how they move. Every client starts with a detailed assessment, and she also teaches Hypopressives and runs workshops.
name: Core Pilates Oban

name: Oban Physiotherapy and Pilates

headline: Performance-focused coaching in Oban
bio: Finlay Carmichael offers performance-focused coaching for people who want to get stronger, fitter and more athletic, with structured training, running and nutrition in place of random sessions. New clients start with a connection call.
name: Finlay Carmichael PT

headline: Boutique mat and reformer Pilates in Fort William

name: Forme Studio FW

headline: Mountain bike coaching and personal training in Fort William
bio: Euan runs MTB Coaching and Fitness in Fort William, combining mountain bike skills coaching with personal training sessions. Riders praise his friendly approach and the way he breaks skills down to simple steps.
name: MTB Coaching and Fitness

bio: Haar Pilates is a reformer and mat studio on Kirkcaldy High Street, also offering barre and private sessions. It describes itself as built on kindness, knowledge and experience rather than trends.

headline: Small mat Pilates and barre classes in Kirkcaldy
bio: Anna McLean has over 10 years of experience teaching Pilates and barre in Kirkcaldy. Classes are small, with postural assessment and hands-on corrections, and there is a video library for practising at home.

bio: Maximum Results is a fully coached functional fitness facility in King's Lynn. Small group sessions cover strength and conditioning, Olympic weightlifting and HYROX, with youth development and an on-site chiropractic clinic.
name: Maximum Results

name: Just4You Fitness

headline: Personal trainer, health and menopause coach in King's Lynn
bio: Trish Betts is a personal trainer and health and menopause coach in King's Lynn. She offers personalised training and health coaching to help clients take back control of their fitness.

name: Pole Kinetics PT

headline: Pilates and wellness studio in Grantham

name: Amaras Reset Studio

headline: Soft tissue therapy and Pilates in Grantham

name: Exhale Therapy

headline: Private mat and reformer Pilates studio in Boston

headline: Personal training studio in Boston, 1-to-1 or small groups

headline: Personal trainer and menopause exercise specialist in Bury St Edmunds
bio: Ruth Murphy is an experienced personal trainer and weight management consultant in Bury St Edmunds. She offers circuits, core, weights and functional training, and specialises in pre and postnatal and menopause exercise.
name: Ruth Murphy PT

bio: Energise Personal Fitness in Bury St Edmunds offers personal training packages, swim teaching and coaching, youth strength and conditioning, pre and postnatal fitness, nutrition and sports massage.

headline: Independent PT studio near Bury for people in their 40s to 60s
bio: Alchemy PT is an independent personal training studio in Depden near Bury St Edmunds. It helps adults in their 40s, 50s and 60s who have never felt at home in a gym to get stronger, fitter and more confident.
